silent_decisions.decision: no overdrafts: withdrawal, transfer and split may not take the balance below 0
daily withdrawal cap of 5000 per account
a repeated txnId with a different payload (other account, other operation, other amount) is acknowledged and ignored
an unknown account reads as balance 0 / empty history, and operations on a never-opened account open it implicitly
open() on an existing account is a silent no-op
amount validated before rounding: a positive amount below half a cent is accepted and recorded as 0 (a 0-cent withdrawal still pays the minimum fee)
insufficient funds (including the fee) is checked before the daily limit
transfers and split payments do not count toward the daily withdrawal limit
a rejected operation consumes neither its txnId nor daily-limit allowance
entries() returns a copy; changing it does not change the history
amount validation happens before the duplicate-txnId check
the withdrawal fee is rounded UP to the cent (1% of 100.01 = 1.0001 -> 1.01)
the withdrawal fee is capped at 25.00
the funds check includes the fee: a withdrawal of the whole balance is rejected
the daily limit counts the withdrawn amount without the fee
interest is rounded DOWN (truncated) to the cent
interest that rounds to 0 cents is not credited: the call returns ok, no entry is recorded and the txnId is not consumed
a split's leftover cents go one each to the first recipients in list order
a foreign deposit that converts to less than half a cent is rejected with 'amount-too-small' (unlike a plain sub-half-cent deposit, which is accepted as 0)
a split with no recipients is rejected with 'no-recipients'
a non-positive interest rate or day count, or a non-positive exchange rate, is rejected as 'invalid-amount'
transfers and split payments are not charged a fee

not_implemented.what: transfer to the same account is not rejected
the fee is not recorded as its own history entry: the withdrawal entry carries amount + fee
foreign conversion rounds halves away from zero (up), not to even: 2.50 at 0.01 = 0.025 -> 0.03 instead of 0.02

decided_by_the_plan: amounts rounded to the nearest cent, halves away from zero (P-011)
withdrawal fee of 1% with a minimum of 0.50 (P-012)
interest computed with a 365-day year on the current balance (P-015)
a split divides the amount evenly (P-016)
foreign amount converted at the given rate (P-014, conversion part)
